title: Hackathon Disruptive DataHack
summary: A hackathon project (Task 3) of Jupyter notebooks that model German credit and loan datasets and generate large synthetic samples (100x the original row count) for data augmentation. It builds SDV SingleTableMetadata objects and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer, checking output quality with evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic.
